record.context_brief: Pairs of Jordan types in codimension two
record.original_question: Fix a Hilbert function H that occurs for a codimension-two complete intersection algebra. Can one determine all pairs of Jordan types (P, Q) that arise from multiplication by two linear forms ell_1 and ell_2 on an algebra A with H(A) = H?

evidence.quote: Question 5.9. In [10], all possible linear Jordan types of complete intersection algebras of codimension two having a fixed Hilbert function is listed. For every such Hilbert function H, can we determine the pairs of Jordan types P and Q that occur for (ℓ1, A) and (ℓ2, A) where H(A) = H?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $k$ be an algebraically closed field of characteristic zero, and let $A = k[x,y]/I$ be a graded Artinian complete intersection algebra of codimension two, i.e. $I = (f_1, f_2)$ where $f_1, f_2$ is a regular sequence of homogeneous polynomials in $k[x,y]$. Write $H(A) = (h_0, h_1, h_2, \dots)$ for the Hilbert function of $A$, where $h_i = \dim_k A_i$.

For any linear form $\ell \in A_1$, multiplication by $\ell$ defines a nilpotent linear endomorphism $m_\ell : A \to A$ of the finite-dimensional vector space $A$. The Jordan type of $(\ell, A)$ is the partition $P_\ell$ of $\dim_k A$ given by the sizes of the Jordan blocks of $m_\ell$.

Fix a Hilbert function $H$ that occurs for some graded Artinian complete intersection algebra of codimension two. Determine, explicitly and in terms of $H$, the set of all ordered pairs of partitions $(P, Q)$ such that there exist a codimension-two graded Artinian complete intersection algebra $A$ with $H(A) = H$ and linear forms $\ell_1, \ell_2 \in A_1$ for which the Jordan type of $(\ell_1, A)$ equals $P$ and the Jordan type of $(\ell_2, A)$ equals $Q$.
artifact.status_search_result: The single-linear-form Jordan types for codimension-two complete intersections with a given Hilbert function have been classified (work by Altafi–Iarrobino–Khatami–Yaméogo), but the classification of pairs of Jordan types arising from two linear forms appears to be posed as an open question with no published full solution found.

status_evidence.title: Complete intersection Jordan types in height two
status_evidence.snippet: Determines every Jordan type partition occurring for multiplication by a single linear form on a height-two graded complete intersection.
status_evidence.claim: The single-form Jordan type classification is known.

status_evidence.title: Jordan degree type for codimension three Gorenstein algebras of almost constant Hilbert function
status_evidence.snippet: Discusses Jordan degree types and rank matrices following recent results in codimension two and three.
status_evidence.claim: Related ongoing research; pair classification not established.
